senses.gloss:
होलकः Chick-pea or pulse half
parched in the pod.

1 The spring-festival
celebrated at the approach of the
spring season, during the ten-but
particularly three or four-days
preceding the full-moon day in
the month of Phālguna (commonly
called Holi).
--2 The full-moon
day in the month of Phālguna.

होलिका, होली The festival called
होलाका q. v. above.

होलिका, होली The festival called
होलाका q. v. above.
